title: Registry of COVID-19 Patients at AOUI Verona
brief_summary: The registry of COVID-19 patients was designed to collect epidemiolgical, demographic, clinical, anamnestic and outcome information together with serological and microbiological samples from COVID-19 patients admitted at the University Hospital of Verona (Azienda Ospedaliera Universitaria Integrata, AOUI Verona). All SARS-CoV 2 positive patients admitted and able to give an informed consent are included, irrespectively of age and gender.
study_population: COVID-19 patients admitted at the University Hospital of Verona (Azienda Ospedaliera Universitaria Integrata, AOUI Verona).
